The '''Chandrilan Security Bureau''' was an intelligence agency that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In the aftermath of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Damotite bioweapon|bioweapon]] attack on [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Chandrila, in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ordered [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Varrak]] of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] to co-ordinate a response to the attack with the Chandrilan Security Bureau.
